name: bos
description: A collection of agent skills that nobody asked for, but everyone deserves.

interface.shortDescription: agterm session management, peer-agent chat, an agent PM, memory review, and Russian diff review.
interface.longDescription: Skills for driving the agterm terminal (archive, back up and fork sessions), letting Claude and Codex talk across a split pane, delegating work to a fleet of agents, auditing an agent memory directory, and reviewing a diff in revdiff with the prose translated into Russian.
defaultPrompt: Review this diff in Russian with revdiff.
Back up my agterm sessions before I reboot.
Audit my agent memory for stale entries.
